notes.title: Midvinter now available in Ukrainian and Russian!
notes.notes:
Good news, friends - you can now play Midvinter in Ukrainian (Українська) and Russian (Русский)! Just as before, Voice Over and Subtitles are separated, so you can choose whichever combination of languages you like.

Happy gaming!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/23025034/d8bb8815f498649efe54729a2b77d44d0ad937c8.jpg[/img]

notes.title: First patch just went live!
notes.notes:
You have just received a patch (ver 1.0.4) with some fixes to bugs you have reported since release. If you have any other issues, please send an email right away to: support [at] talecore dot com!

Enjoy the game! :)
